THAT report RCP-26-049 titled “ANHS Operational Hours Review” be received as information; and
THAT an annual one-week public closure during the first business week of January be adopted as an operational practice at Annandale National Historic Site (ANHS); and
THAT Saturday public operating hours at ANHS between Victoria Day and August 31 be adopted as a permanent operational practice; and
THAT the extended Thursday operating hours between Victoria Day and August 31 be discontinued.

THAT Council direct staff to prepare a Parkland Protection Policy, and to bring forward any related Official Plan, zoning, parkland dedication, land disposition or reserve-fund amendments required to implement the policy; and
THAT the proposed policy include a provision for Council approval and public notice before the sale, conversion or material encumbrance of municipal parkland, consideration of replacement land and service impacts, and reinvestment of net disposition or land-right proceeds for parkland and recreation purposes.
